# Spiffinity Cleaning & Laundry LLC

> Locally owned residential cleaning company based in Bradenton, Florida, serving Manatee and Sarasota counties. Recurring house cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in/move-out, post-construction and renovation cleaning, apartment and condo cleaning, vacation rental (Airbnb/Vrbo) turnovers, housekeeping and laundry. Homes only: Spiffinity does not offer commercial cleaning. Non-toxic, Green Seal and EPA Safer Choice certified products.

Key facts:
- Business name: Spiffinity Cleaning & Laundry LLC (also "Spiffinity Cleaning")
- Owner: Carol Chartier
- Address: 1470 Millbrook Cir, Bradenton, FL 34212
- Phone: (941) 993-9614
- Email: cchartier@spiffinitycleaning.com
- Hours: Mon–Sat, 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM; closed Sunday
- Service area: Bradenton, Sarasota, Lakewood Ranch, Palmetto, Ellenton, Parrish, Anna Maria Island, Longboat Key, Siesta Key (Florida)
- Quotes: free and no-obligation at https://spiffinitycleaning.com/request-a-quote/
- Fully bonded and insured; trained, background-checked employees; no independent contractors
- 64-point checklist and "Green Clean Routine" on every visit; 24-hour re-clean guarantee for residential clients

## Services (residential only)
- [Residential Cleaning](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/residential-cleaning/): Weekly, bi-weekly or monthly house cleaning with non-toxic products and a room-by-room checklist.
- [Deep Cleaning](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/deep-cleaning/): Top-to-bottom cleaning for homes and vacant properties, including the spots routine cleaning misses.
- [Move-In & Move-Out Cleaning](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/move-in-move-out-cleaning/): Detailed cleaning for empty homes before keys change hands, including cabinets, closets and appliances.
- [Apartment & Condo Cleaning](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/apartment-cleaning/): Studios to multi-bedroom units, cleaned with non-toxic products that are safe in shared-wall buildings.
- [Vacation Rental Cleaning](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/vacation-rental-cleaning/): Fast, guest-ready Airbnb and Vrbo turnovers with linens, restocking and damage reporting.
- [Housekeeping Services](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/housekeeping-services/): Laundry, folding, dishes and tidying, added to your cleaning or booked on its own.
- [Laundry Services](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/laundry-services/): Wash, dry and fold for clothes, linens and towels, with pickup for recurring clients.
- [Post-Construction Cleaning](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/post-construction-cleaning/): New homes, remodels and storm repairs cleaned of dust and residue, ready for move-in day.

## Service areas
- [Bradenton, FL](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/bradenton/): Our home base on the Manatee River. ZIP 34203, 34205, 34207, 34208, 34209, 34210, 34211, 34212.
- [Sarasota, FL](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/sarasota/): Downtown towers to bayfront bungalows. ZIP 34231, 34232, 34233, 34234, 34235, 34236, 34237, 34238, 34239, 34240, 34241, 34243.
- [Lakewood Ranch, FL](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/lakewood-ranch/): Master-planned villages, amenity centers & new builds. ZIP 34202, 34211, 34212, 34240.
- [Palmetto, FL](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/palmetto/): Historic downtown, marina living & new subdivisions. ZIP 34221.
- [Ellenton, FL](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/ellenton/): 55+ living, river views & easy I-75 access. ZIP 34222.
- [Parrish, FL](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/parrish/): Fast-growing new-home communities. ZIP 34219.
- [Anna Maria Island, FL](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/anna-maria-island/): Vacation rentals, beach houses & island rebuilds. ZIP 34216, 34217.
- [Longboat Key, FL](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/longboat-key/): Gulf-front condos & seasonal homes. ZIP 34228.
- [Siesta Key, FL](https://spiffinitycleaning.com/siesta-key/): Quartz-sand beaches & vacation rentals. ZIP 34242.
